notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements v2024.48.6 - New Language Translations!
notes.content:
Hello, flower enthusiasts! 🌸

We’re excited to share with you the latest updates we've implemented to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what we've improved and fixed:

[h3]New Language Translations[/h3]
We’ve introduced support for 14 new languages, making the game more accessible for players around the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/5dd9422a380c71f5b41a75ebf34c5482e83d7fa4.png[/img]

[h3]FOV Settings Expanded[/h3]
We’ve extended the Field of View (FOV) range, allowing adjustments up to 120, giving you more control over your gameplay visuals.

[h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b] NPC Customer Issue Resolved[/b]: Fixed the bug where NPC customers would not appear.
[*][b] Flower Pot Disappearance Issue Fixed[/b]: Addressed the issue where flower pots would vanish from venues during the venue decoration missions.
[/list]
We appreciate all the feedback and bug reports from our dedicated players. Your input helps us improve the game with every update. Please continue sharing your thoughts, and as always, happy arranging! 💐

Cheers!

notes.title: Explore the Beautiful Map in Florist Business Simulator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/1b10f53683762bb0c87f1df3a076f9a3bf6dacf6.png[/img]

Hello, flower enthusiasts! 🌼

Today, we’re diving deep into the Map feature, an essential part of your flower-filled journey where nature’s beauty meets business strategy. As you explore the stunning landscapes, each location offers unique resources, challenges, and opportunities to expand your flourishing florist business.

[h2]The World of Florist Business Simulator[/h2]
The map is divided into three distinct regions: White Forest, Black Forest, and Homebase. Each area offers a variety of flowers, landscapes, and experiences that will shape how you gather resources, craft beautiful arrangements, and grow your business.

[b]White Forest: A Tranquil Paradise[/b]
The White Forest is where serenity meets beauty. Covered in soft sunlight and dotted with pristine white flowers, it’s the perfect place to begin your adventure. Here, you’ll find some of the rarest flowers that thrive in peaceful, open meadows.  While the White Forest offers some of the highest-value flowers, it’s also the most challenging place to navigate, filled with rugged terrains and more difficult paths to traverse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/6ee84cebc080888b155be95bbf0630b21ccd3425.png[/img]

[b]Black Forest: A Mysterious Expedition[/b]
In contrast, the Black Forest is a place where mystery and adventure come alive. This dense, shadowy forest is home to dark-colored flowers and rare, exotic species hidden deep within its thickets. This is the region where nature reveals its gentler side, offering the player a low-stress environment to gather and explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/0fc4d223b713b00a1e5c3b0d48e0c16330cee274.png[/img]

[b]Homebase: Your Florist Headquarters[/b]
Homebase is your personal sanctuary—a place to rest, regroup, and manage your ever-growing florist business. From here, you’ll plan your next expedition, prepare flower arrangements, and selling your collection. The time spent here is vital to ensuring that your business runs smoothly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/5fc2f6c7f8a9473e1cac5973e385d66ec7fd52f1.png[/img]

[h2]A World of Endless Opportunities[/h2]
As you explore these regions, you'll gather a diverse array of flowers, each with unique characteristics and value. The White and Black Forests offer you the opportunity to connect with nature while finding the perfect blooms to create stunning floral arrangements that will delight your customers back at Homebase.

We’ve designed these areas to give you both beauty and challenge—whether it’s the serene calm of the White Forest or the thrilling exploration of the Black Forest. Balancing time spent in nature with managing your business is key to becoming the ultimate florist.

[h2]Join Our Floral Journey![/h2]
We can't wait for you to dive into Florist Business Simulator and experience these breathtaking landscapes for yourself! Be sure to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] on Steam to stay updated on all future devlogs and the official release date. Your support helps us bloom into something beautiful, just like the flowers you’ll arrange in the game!

If you have any questions about the features discussed or anything related to the game, feel free to leave a comment or post on our discussion forum. Your feedback and inquiries are highly valuable to us!

Cheers!

notes.title: Design Your Success: Meet the Customer Project
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/74020f0805aa7acb0a780a6d5f1ab461a593f805.png[/img]

Hello, flower enthusiasts! 🌼

We’re back with another exciting update for Florist Business Simulator! Today, we’re unveiling a feature that will transform how you interact with your customers: [b]Customer Project[/b]. This innovative addition will deepen your engagement with the game and challenge your creativity as you bring your floral visions to life.

[h2]What is the Customer Project?[/h2]
Customer Project allows you to interact with a diverse array of clients who have specific floral needs. As you grow your business, you’ll be tasked with collecting flowers to decorating venue with your beautiful flower arrangements. This feature is designed to simulate the real-world dynamics of running a florist shop, where every customer brings their own vision to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/bedd85b27666651c1475e46a51b8cd8c08f0af95.png[/img]

[h2]Key Elements of the "Customer Project"[/h2]
[b]Client Requests[/b]
[list]
[*] Players receive various customer requests through a dynamic in-game messaging system. These requests vary in complexity and style, from simple bouquets to decorating venue for special events.
[*] Each customer will provide details such as flower types, occasions (weddings, anniversaries, corporate events), and fee, ensuring a diverse range of projects to tackle.
[/list]
[b]Rewards [/b]
Successfully completing projects will reward you with [b]Money Fee[/b] and [b]Reputation Point[/b]. This progression system encourages you to tackle increasingly challenging requests as you advance in your florist career.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/fcbf3ce6ba6eefa1f2501378d101c1ad0077dcfa.png[/img]

[h2]Why "Customer Project" Matters[/h2]
The introduction of Customer Project adds layers of engagement and realism to Florist Business Simulator. By simulating the challenges and rewards of real-world floral business dynamics, players will develop a deeper appreciation for the craft and the art of floral design.

This feature encourages players to think creatively, adapt to customer needs, and manage their time effectively. It’s about more than just selling flowers; it’s about building relationships and creating memorable experiences for your clients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/c22d35a6c979fa19c595b61111abdb3cc8d1ddae.png[/img]

[h2]Join the Floral Revolution![/h2]
The Customer Project feature is designed to immerse you in the world of floristry, where every arrangement tells a story and every customer interaction matters. We believe this addition will elevate your gameplay, providing you with new challenges and creative opportunities.

We invite you to [b]wishlist Florist Business Simulator[/b] on Steam! By adding our game to your wishlist, you’ll be among the first to receive updates and news about our upcoming features, including Customer Project. Your support means the world to us and helps us bring our floral dreams to life.

If you have any questions about the features discussed or anything related to the game, feel free to leave a comment or post on our discussion forum. Your feedback and inquiries are highly valuable to us!

Get ready to bloom!

Cheers!

notes.title: Managing Your Collection with the Flower Inventory
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/2033cd0237d465b2127d7bad5252a1c878612e41.png[/img]

Hello, flower enthusiasts! 🌼

We’re thrilled to bring you another exciting update from the world of [b]Florist Business Simulator[/b]. Today, we’re diving deep into a feature that will transform the way you manage your floral creations: the [b]Flower Inventory[/b]. This comprehensive system is designed to enhance your gameplay experience by allowing you to efficiently track, organize, and utilize the stunning flowers you collect. Let’s explore its features and benefits!

[h2]🌷 Organize and Track Your Flowers[/h2]
The Flower Inventory is where all your collected flowers are stored, offering a comprehensive overview of your floral collection. As you explore the wild landscapes, each type of flower you gather will be cataloged here. The inventory system is designed to help you keep track of your flowers with ease. From daisies and roses to exotic blooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/70a4aa7be9450ce8867376e67b00d64dee0dc63d.png[/img]

[h2]🌺 Manage Stock for Maximum Profit[/h2]
Being a florist isn’t just about beauty; it’s also about business. Keeping an eye on your inventory levels ensures you can sell flowers at peak demand without running out of stock. The more efficiently you manage your flower stock, the more you can profit from your sales, especially when you participate in special events or serve high-profile clients. Through careful stock management, you’ll learn when to gather more flowers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/b0bddbd0a5e514f9c28d47a3a6488f689144e2c8.png[/img]

[h2]🌸 Your Florist Journey Awaits![/h2]
We hope you’re excited about the Flower Inventory feature and can’t wait for you to experience it firsthand! If you haven’t already, be sure to [b]add Florist Business Simulator to your wishlist[/b] on Steam. Stay tuned for more devlogs and updates as we continue to add new features and polish the game.

If you have any questions about the features discussed or anything related to the game, feel free to leave a comment or post on our discussion forum. Your feedback and inquiries are highly valuable to us!

Cheers!

notes.title: Immerse Yourself in the 4 Seasons of Nature!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/b258c56bfccef030ecb4e21e29cfc8cd33da8f22.png[/img]

Hello, flower enthusiast!

In our latest feature spotlight, we’re thrilled to introduce the 4 Seasons in Nature system, a core element in Florist Business Simulator that offers an immersive, peaceful exploration experience through beautifully crafted landscapes, where you’ll hunt for unique flowers all year round.

[h2]A Journey Through the Seasons[/h2]
Nature has always been our greatest inspiration, and in Florist Business Simulator, we wanted to create a dynamic world where the changing seasons play a crucial role in how you experience the environment and discover flowers.
[list]
[*] [b]Spring[/b]: As the world awakens from winter, you'll explore vibrant meadows filled with blooming tulips and daisies. Listen to the songs of birds as you search for seasonal flowers in the rich, dew-kissed soil.
[*] [b]Summer[/b]: The warmth of summer brings an abundance of life to every corner. This is the perfect time to find sunflowers and roses in full bloom. Wander through sunny fields and along riversides, soaking in the warmth while you gather flowers that thrive under the summer sun.
[*] [b]Autumn[/b]: As the leaves turn fiery shades of red and gold, a serene calm takes over the landscape. Autumn offers a more muted, yet breathtaking palette, with flowers like chrysanthemums and asters peeking through the fallen leaves. This season invites reflection as you walk through misty forests and rolling hills.
[*] [b]Winter[/b]: Even in the coldest months, nature has its beauty. Winter is a time of resilience, where you’ll find frost-covered evergreens and delicate snowdrops emerging through the snow. The quiet stillness of winter offers a unique tranquility as you search for the season’s most hardy blooms.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/8c203da7684676a9c60940a52cc952c5fba417c5.png[/img]

[h2]Embrace the Beauty of Nature[/h2]
The 4 Seasons in Nature feature is designed to help you slow down, breathe in the fresh air, and simply enjoy the serene beauty that each season offers. Whether you're wandering through the golden fields of autumn or enjoying the serene snowfall in winter, this feature invites you to connect with nature on a deeper level, appreciating the subtle details that make each season special.

[h2]Discover Unique Flowers[/h2]
Each season not only brings a change in scenery but also offers rare and season-specific flowers that can’t be found at any other time of the year. This makes exploration vital if you want to expand your collection of flowers for creating unique floral arrangements in your business. Some flowers might even be hidden in hard-to-reach areas, encouraging players to carefully explore each landscape for hidden treasures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/6dd13c27dc8bb7af44058622bda73c43b9814dbc.png[/img]

[h2]Your Florist Adventure Awaits![/h2]
The 4 Seasons in Nature feature adds yet another layer of depth to your florist journey. Not only will you enhance your skills as a florist by discovering seasonal flowers, but you’ll also get to experience the changing beauty of nature throughout the year.

Don't forget to wishlist Florist Business Simulator on Steam to stay up to date on our latest updates and features! Every season brings a new adventure, and we can't wait for you to experience the full beauty of nature in the game. 🌸

If you have any questions about the features discussed or anything related to the game, feel free to leave a comment or post on our discussion forum. Your feedback and inquiries are highly valuable to us!

Cheers!

notes.title: Embrace Nature’s Beauty with “Immersive Nature” Environment!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/38a2694089560df03e6e88933fe41a22cd148f02.png[/img]

Hello, flower enthusiasts!

Today, we’re excited to introduce a feature we believe will enhance your connection to nature and add depth to your floral journey—[b]Immersive Nature[/b] environment. This feature takes players on a peaceful exploration through some of the most breathtaking landscapes you’ve ever seen, where you’ll search for unique flowers that can’t be found anywhere else.

[h2]A Relaxing Journey through Nature’s Wonders[/h2]
We wanted to offer something truly special—a chance for you to explore environments at your own pace. From rolling hills covered in vibrant wildflowers to serene forests filled with the soft hum of life, these landscapes offer tranquility like no other. Each location is designed to draw you in, allowing you to fully experience the beauty and richness of nature.

The grass beneath your feet, listen to the gentle sound of the wind through the trees, and let the natural world inspire your creativity. Wandering through a colorful field of seasonal blossoms, waiting for you to discover its secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/0fc4d223b713b00a1e5c3b0d48e0c16330cee274.png[/img]

[h2]Search for Unique and Stunning Blooms[/h2]
While the journey is soothing, it’s also one of discovery. Hidden in these landscapes are unique and exotic flowers, just waiting to be found. The thrill of stumbling upon a never-before-seen bloom makes each expedition rewarding. These flowers are not only beautiful but also key to setting your flower arrangements.

With each trip, you’ll encounter different species, colors, and forms of flora, giving you endless possibilities for the floral masterpieces you’ll create in your shop. Some flowers will only bloom in specific season, adding an extra layer of depth and exploration to your journey.

[h2]Find Inspiration in Nature[/h2]
Immersive Nature is not just about gathering resources—it’s about slowing down and letting nature inspire your creativity. As you wander through these scenic environments, you’ll find yourself enchanted by the sheer variety of flowers, plants, and natural phenomena around you. These moments aren’t just about gameplay; they’re about appreciating the little details that make nature so extraordinary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/6ee84cebc080888b155be95bbf0630b21ccd3425.png[/img]

[h2]A Core Part of Your Florist Journey[/h2]
While this feature brings peace and reflection, it also plays a vital role in your florist business. The flowers you collect through these serene expeditions can make all the difference in setting your shop apart. These rare blooms allow you to create truly remarkable floral arrangements that will leave your clients in awe, adding a unique flair to your designs and giving you an edge in the competitive world of floristry.

[h2]Join Our Floral Journey[/h2]
We’re excited to share this peaceful slice of Florist Business Simulator with you, and we think you’ll love what Immersive Nature brings to the table. If you’re ready to explore beautiful landscapes and gather nature’s treasures, be sure to add Florist Business Simulator to your wishlist. This way, you’ll be among the first to know when we’re ready to release the game!

If you have any questions about the features discussed or anything related to the game, feel free to leave a comment or post on our discussion forum. Your feedback and inquiries are highly valuable to us!

Thanks for being part of this floral journey, and we can’t wait for you to explore these stunning worlds soon.

Cheers!

notes.title: Elevate Event Venues with Stunning Floral Designs in Florist Business Simulator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/c22d35a6c979fa19c595b61111abdb3cc8d1ddae.png[/img]

Hello, flower enthusiasts!

We’re thrilled to introduce one of the standout features of Florist Business Simulator – the "[b]Decorate Venue[/b]" mode. This is where your floral creativity truly blossoms, as you transform ordinary event spaces into awe-inspiring masterpieces. Whether you're designing for a dreamy wedding, a grand corporate event, or a cozy private celebration, your skills will be put to the test to turn any venue into a visual wonderland.

[h2]Diverse Events, Endless Creativity[/h2]
Events are the heart of your business, and each one presents a new opportunity to showcase your creativity:
[list]
[*] [b]Weddings[/b]: Transform a bride’s dream into reality with soft, romantic flower designs that capture the essence of love and commitment. Your arrangements should reflect the couple’s unique style.
[*] [b]Corporate Event[/b]: For large-scale corporate events, precision and grandeur are key. Think sophisticated and bold designs that match the formality and professionalism of the occasion.
[*] [b]Private Celebrations[/b]: These cozy, personal gatherings require a more intimate touch. Small-scale events let you experiment with warm, welcoming arrangements that create an unforgettable atmosphere for the guests.
[/list]
Each event allows you to dive deep into your floral inventory, experimenting with color schemes, textures, and various arrangement techniques to make the venue shine. Every decision counts, as the final result will not only reflect your creativity but also your ability to meet (and exceed) the client’s expectations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/e75e34d4b8dec579db94753c12f779352005394b.png[/img]

[h2]Showcasing Your Expertise[/h2]
In Florist Business Simulator, decorating venues is more than just placing flowers. It’s about elevating the ambiance and creating an immersive experience that stays with your clients and their guests long after the event ends. You’ll have access to:
[list]
[*][b] A wide selection of flowers[/b], from rare orchids to everyday favorites like roses and tulips.
[*][b] Customizable flower arrangements[/b], allowing you to mix and match styles, colors, and themes to fit your clients' vision.
[/list]
Your design choices will affect the mood and energy of the space, and feedback from your clients will reflect your success. Are your arrangements bold enough to make an impression at a grand gala? Subtle enough to enhance the intimacy of a small celebration? Each venue gives you an opportunity to [b]let your creativity shine[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/f97b664354502f9dd9059c5970d937e5f55ba9e7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Get Ready to Build Your Floral Legacy![/h2]
We can’t wait for you to experience the thrill of transforming venues and watching your floral business grow. With the "Decorate Venue" feature, you’ll have the tools to make every event a success.

Be sure to [b]add Florist Business Simulator to your Steam wishlist[/b] to stay up-to-date on all the latest features and news. The world of floral design awaits you, and we’re thrilled for you to begin this exciting journey with us. 🌻

If you have any questions about the features discussed or anything related to the game, feel free to leave a comment or post on our discussion forum. Your feedback and inquiries are highly valuable to us!

Stay tuned for more updates, and let your floral creativity flourish! 🌹

Cheers!

notes.title: The Art Of Flower Arrangement
notes.content:
Hello, flower enthusiasts!

Today, we’re thrilled to introduce one of the most exciting features of Florist Business Simulator—the [b]Flower Arrangement [/b]system! Whether you're an experienced florist or just beginning your journey into the world of floral design, this feature lets you dive deep into the beauty of flowers and unleash your creative potential like never before.


[h2]Craft Your Own Floral Masterpieces[/h2]

In Florist Business Simulator, the Flower Arrangement feature is all about exploring and expressing your artistic vision. With no constraints, you can craft stunning floral arrangements that reflect your personal style and aesthetic preferences.

Choose from a variety of pots and vases to serve as the foundation for your designs. Each option is unique, allowing you to personalize your arrangement with the perfect vessel. Whether you prefer sleek and modern styles or something more rustic and organic, you'll find the right base to complement your floral vision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/de7692def688239c779840ace1fdc6c8002faa9b.jpg[/img]


[h2]Endless Design Combinations[/h2]

The real beauty of the Flower Arrangement feature lies in the ability to mix and match a wide array of flowers  in various colors to create something entirely unique. Each bloom adds its own character, giving you the freedom to explore different themes and moods in your arrangements.

Here’s what to expect:
[list]
[*] Diverse Flower Selection: Play around with bold and subtle color schemes. Use complementary colors for striking contrasts or a harmonious palette of soft hues for a calming, sophisticated arrangement.
[*] Color Harmony: Play with vivid colors to evoke emotions or match the themes of your clients. Blend warm tones for romantic bouquets or cool hues for a calming, elegant arrangement.
[*] Flexible Styles: Whether you’re aiming for a symmetrical, formal design or an organic, free-flowing bouquet, the tools at your disposal allow for ultimate flexibility. 
[/list]

[h2]Immerse Yourself in a Peaceful Design Experience[/h2]

This mode was designed for those moments when you want to unwind and immerse yourself in the world of flowers. With the Flower Arrangement feature, you can lose yourself in the details of crafting the perfect bouquet without the pressures of time or competition. It’s a solo, stress-free experience where you can enjoy the process of arranging, experimenting, and discovering new combinations at your own pace.


[h2]Join Us on Floral Journey[/h2]

If you’re as excited about this feature, make sure to wishlist Florist Business Simulator on Steam! By wishlisting the game, you’ll stay up-to-date with the latest news, updates, and announcements as we continue to develop this one-of-a-kind experience.

We can’t wait for you to step into the world of floristry and start creating beautiful designs that will inspire and delight. Let your creativity bloom! 🌷🌻

Cheers!
